dialogue.speaker: Wei
dialogue.text: 你好，您对这套公寓感兴趣，对吗？
dialogue.en: Hello, you are interested in the apartment, right?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 是的。房租每个月多少钱？
dialogue.en: Yes. How much is the rent per month?

dialogue.speaker: Wei
dialogue.text: 每个月八百，而且公寓带家具。
dialogue.en: It is eight hundred a month, and the apartment is furnished.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 听起来不错。我需要付押金吗？
dialogue.en: That sounds good. Do I have to pay a deposit?

dialogue.speaker: Wei
dialogue.text: 需要，一个月房租作为押金。我们明天签合同。
dialogue.en: Yes, one month as a deposit. We sign the contract tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 太好了。决定之前，我能再看一下厨房吗？
dialogue.en: Great. Can I see the kitchen again before I decide?
